title: Startup Advisory — Day 3: Entity Structuring and Investor Preferences
takeaway: If a founder intends to raise equity capital or grant ESOPs, incorporate a Private Limited Company from day one; fixing an LLP or OPC later costs thrice as much.
action: Draft a 5-point WhatsApp text comparing Pvt Ltd vs LLP for early founders and share it with 2 founder friends or batchmates building startups.
